title: Defense stocks rise, Pakistan shares drop after Trump's Afghanistan speech
主要内容: Defense stocks rose following remarks from Trump's Afghanistan speech, while Pakistani stocks fell, with the KSE 100 index dropping 2.2 percent on Tuesday. Trump warned of a 'vacuum' created by a swift U.S. troop withdrawal and criticized Pakistan for harboring militants. U.S. defense companies saw gains, with Lockheed Martin and Boeing advancing over 0.7%. The U.S. can no longer be silent about Pakistan's safe havens for terrorist organizations, the Taliban and others, that pose a threat to the region and beyond.
